shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab / stela carved in low relief
anthropomorphic figure with limbs shown frontally or in profile
horizontal band of repeated motifs near an edge
raised relief against a plain recessed ground
justification: Both are tall, roughly rectangular stone slabs carved in relief with animals, serpentine bodies and anthropomorphic figures, and both use a horizontal band of small repeated units as a framing register, which is the most specific correspondence. The difference is decisive: A is sparse, shallow and schematic with isolated motifs floating on large blank ground and stacked in loose registers, while B is a dense, deeply undercut, horror-vacui composition organised around a single central standing figure with elaborate interlaced ornament filling every space.
